meta.name: firebase-data-connect
meta.description: Builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect (aka Firebase Data Connect) backends with PostgreSQL securely. Use when designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time data updates, or generating type-safe SDKs. Use when you need a relational database with Firebase, or when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect.

howto.what: 帮你在 Firebase 上构建和部署基于 PostgreSQL 的 SQL Connect(原 Data Connect)后端:设计数据表与关系、编写授权操作、生成类型安全 SDK 等。
howto.when: 当你提到 SQL Connect(旧称 Data Connect),或需要设计数据表、编写授权查询等时触发。

say.text: 帮我为电影应用设计电影和演员的表关系
给用户的查询加授权,只允许本人访问
say.note: Claude 会加入 @auth 等权限标记。

say.text: 为我的 Android 项目生成 Kotlin SDK
say.note: Claude 会运行 SDK 生成命令并输出到指定目录。

howto.what_en: Helps you build and deploy Firebase SQL Connect backends (PostgreSQL-based): design tables and relations, write authorized operations, generate type-safe SDKs, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention SQL Connect (formerly Data Connect), need a relational database with Firebase, or ask to design schemas.

say_en.text: Design a schema for a movie app with tables for movies and actors.
Add authorization to user queries so users see only their own data.
Generate a Kotlin SDK for my Android project.
say_en.note: Runs SDK generation into the configured output dir.
